provenance.why: tools/tmp/headserve.mjs archived this commit and served it at http://localhost:63645

bakedInRegressions: playerRankMedian 19.5 -> 30. THE BIG ONE, and nobody chose it. The player's own screen region lost ~10 places in the 16x9 salience grid across 3dcbc9a..36ee0a6 (238 commits, 104 touching src/, +32,898 lines). It is real, it is measured on BOTH trees today (see `supersedes.reMeasuredToday`), and it is the reference now — so it is INVISIBLE to every future run. It accumulated over many passes and is attributable to none of them; the stale baseline reported it as one REGRESSION row on every arm for six days, including both arms of a HEAD-to-HEAD drift control, which is why three agents in one night were told to disregard the line. If the hero should out-read the arena, this is the number to attack, and attacking it needs a fresh paired A/B, not this gate.

warmChroma 0.0596 FAILs its band (floor 0.0725, target 0.145) — the ONE rail still out of contract. Improved from 0.0525 at 3dcbc9a but still 41% of the reference. `--gate` still fires on it; the drift gate will not, because it is the baseline now. arenaWarmChroma 0.0580 WARNs for the same reason. WARM IS THE SCARCE BUDGET and adding cool is no longer a free lever: coolChroma is already 19% over its target.

RESOLUTION FLOOR, measured not assumed: playerRankMedian +/- ~1.5 PLACES on an identical tree. FOUR full sweeps of pinned 36ee0a6 (shots/sc/{A-36ee0a6, B-36ee0a6-drift, D-installed-check, E-final}) gave 29.5 / 29.5 / 31 / 30. SEVENTEEN of eighteen stations were rank-IDENTICAL in all four; the entire spread comes from fog_inside alone, which read 27 / 26 / 37 / 30, because its frame carries the HUD's breathing screen-edge wash and the salience grid re-ranks with the CSS phase. DO NOT ACT ON A playerRankMedian MOVE UNDER ~1.5 PLACES. The gate fires at +4, i.e. ~2.7x the floor -- real, but nothing like the ~100x the chroma rails enjoy (every chroma aggregate spread across the same four sweeps was <= 0.0006).

This baseline was taken WITHOUT --still-hud (`provenance.stillHud: false`), so it is an unbiased sample of the shipped look and carries the floor above. --still-hud collapses that floor to zero but freezes the HUD keyframes at t=0, which is a BIASED sample; the two are not comparable and `--baseline` refuses to compare them silently.

RESOLVED since the 3dcbc9a baseline, recorded so nobody re-opens them: warmShare 0.1195 -> 0.1258 is back INSIDE the band [0.120, 0.450]; and arenaCoolChroma's missing `freeAbove` flag -- which the previous baseline flagged as making one rail rate a move `ok` while its HUD-free sibling called the same move a REGRESSION -- has been added, so 0.3959 -> 0.4219 now rates `ok` on both.

supersedes.whyReplaced: Six days and 238 commits stale (104 touching src/). It fired exactly one row — `player salience rank (median) 19.5 -> 31, REGRESSION` — on every run, including BOTH arms of a HEAD-to-HEAD drift control (1a5b808 re-established it on a pinned ref containing none of the change under test). A gate that always fires gets switched off.

reMeasuredToday.what: The PAIRED CONTROL that settles what the old baseline actually was. `3dcbc9a` was re-served from `git archive` and swept again on 2026-08-11 with the CURRENT tool (shots/sc/C-3dcbc9a-knownbad).
reMeasuredToday.conclusion: Reproduces to <=0.0002 on every rail and EXACTLY on playerRankMedian. So the old baseline was NOT corrupt and was NOT inventing a number — it described 3dcbc9a correctly. The failure was purely STALENESS: the arena moved 10 rank places under it and every run since attributed that to whatever change was being tested. It also proves the current tool measures identically to the one that wrote the old file, so this re-baseline is a change of REFERENCE, not of INSTRUMENT.

proof.note: Every arm served from `git archive` through tools/tmp/headserve.mjs pinned to an EXPLICIT sha, so no peer commit could enter one. Banners read back.
proof.driftControlOnTheShippedFile: F: 36ee0a6 vs THIS FILE -> 0 colour regressions, exit 0 (shots/sc/F-shipped-drift). The row that fired on every arm of the old baseline reads `player salience rank (median) 30 -> 31, further, ok` — inside its own +/-1.5 floor and far under the +4 gate.
proof.knownBad: C: 3dcbc9a vs this baseline -> 4 REGRESSIONS, exit 1 (shots/sc/C-3dcbc9a-knownbad): meanSat -0.0270, meanChroma -0.0456, arenaMeanSat -0.0363, and warmShare LEFT the band [0.120, 0.450]. The re-baseline is not toothless.
